description: Implementation of a service class for reading GL Closure data from the database, including methods to retrieve all closures and by ID, with internal mapping logic.

classes.name: GLClosureReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing GLClosureReadPlatformService to fetch GL Closure data from database.

classes.name: GLClosureMapper
classes.description: Internal class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set to GLClosureData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAllGLClosures
methods.description: Retrieves all GL Closures, optionally filtered by office ID, ordered by closing date descending.

methods.name: retrieveGLClosureById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific GL Closure by its ID, throws exception if not found.
